notes.title: Release chapter six!
Chapter five release!
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

Chapter five is finally released, and it was the most challenging of all, as it is divided into three paths.
What's new:

* 3 new CG;
* new BG;
* 4 new illustrations for fairytales;
* 3 new achievements;
* two new suits at the love interest's.

Now let's get to the list of changes:

* The map now has a skip button. It will not affect the gameplay, so if you don't want to explore the estate again, you can just skip it.

* Other characters have been added to the wardrobe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/b7258de2ba75ebd4fb8b148c4236a89001312fc2.png[/img]

* Relationship Scale. You can now see your relationship progress. However, the stats do not show all possible relationships in the game. The progress button is located on the textbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42792636/be9a68fce653dea1d0e4389ae1fe69bf29f22b5b.png[/img]

* Small visual adjustments that most likely no one will notice, but they are there~

Thank you so much for staying with us!

notes.title: Release of chapter four
notes.notes:
Hi!
Chapter four is finally out. Since I was previously busy with another project, the release was a bit delayed.
So, what's new:

* 7 new CG
* 2 new BG
* 2 new story illustrations
* 18к~ word

In the next chapter, the plot will develop more individually depending on the root chosen in the third chapter. There will also be a different chapter title for each character.

In news: a new project is planned, the page for which can be viewed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345700/_/]here[/url].

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi!
We have released a small update. We hope everything is working as it should!
What's new:
- The English version of the third chapter has been patched. There will probably be another patch on this early next year. For now, we're checking it out.
- Added the main character's closet. Yay! All costumes from the finished chapters are now available. The next ones will be unlocked as the game progresses. Right now there are two locked costumes.
- Added character profiles.
- The music in the main menu now starts more smoothly.
- A small fix for Daniel's sprite. Don't worry, only the collarbones are fixed =D

We congratulate you on the coming new year! We hope that in the new year we will please you with a new project! ^_^

notes.title: New release and about the fourth chapter
notes.notes:
Hi!
The project that has been clamoring for attention is finally finished: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1268200/Espresso_For_The_Demon/]Espresso For The Demon[/url]
As for the fourth chapter of Bride Of Darkness, it will be released around February-March. This time there will be more focus on the division into routines, as well as plans to add a gallery of the heroine's outfits, as they are becoming very numerous.
More specific dates are likely to be announced in January.

notes.title: Chapter three release!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Here it is, finally the release of the third chapter. Unfortunately, there were some difficulties that have nothing to do with the game, and the release was a bit delayed. 
This chapter is a transitional chapter and the last in the overall plot. Next, the heroine chooses with whom to spend more time and, accordingly, whose secrets to reveal.

As usual, dates for the next chapter will be announced at a later date.
Thank you for being with us!
